proposedStyleProfile.shapeLanguage: Readable faceted silhouettes with simplified organic masses and deliberately low polygon density.

silhouetteHierarchy.guidance: Keep trunks, canopies, rock masses, and groundcover clusters readable at world scale.
Preserve the few large angular breaks that distinguish variants without adding fine noise.

detailScale.guidance: Use broad color blocks and authored facets; avoid microdetail that competes with the silhouette.

proposedStyleProfile.edgeTreatment: Retain authored hard-edged low-poly facets and clean silhouette transitions.
proposedStyleProfile.materialLanguage: Use the authored matte color-blocked materials with restrained highlights and no synthesized surface wear.

surfaceVariation.guidance: Retain authored color variation; add no compiler-authored mottling.

exclusions: Do not add edge wear or dirt during catalog realization.

proposedStyleProfile.lightingIntent: Read as matte stylized outdoor forms under world-level lighting.
antiGoals: Do not infer interchangeability from the shared visual family.
Do not smooth away the authored faceted silhouette.
Do not replace authored materials with photorealistic textures.

selectionRationale: Twenty-four non-LOD sources from one visually inspected low-poly outdoor family: eight individual trees, six individual rocks, six shrubs or groundcover plants, and four fallen-log or stump props. Every proposal remains a singleton substitution set.
reviewProcedure: Inspect every 12-view contact sheet, including unlit base color, depth, silhouette, and surface-normal evidence.
Confirm the proposed denotation and whole-object realization independently of the filename.

Confirm bottom support, upright orientation, completeness, materials, and collision suitability against the measured record. planar_patch_fit carries a positive fitted area; lower_extrema proves only Y-up bottom alignment and carries zero planar area.
Approve the shared style profile only if every accepted source is visually coherent with it.
Mark uncertainty incomplete and any contradicted semantic, geometric, rights, or installation claim rejected.
